name: Touch the edge
subtitle: REACH SPACE
history: On 12 April 1961, Yuri Gagarin became the first human to orbit Earth aboard Vostok 1. Your fictional programme begins with an uncrewed suborbital science flight.
objective: Cross 100 km, record atmospheric observations, and transmit the results.

name: A world in motion
subtitle: EARTH ORBIT
history: Sputnik 1 entered Earth orbit on 4 October 1957. Orbit is continuous free fall around Earth: altitude alone does not keep a satellite in space.
objective: Reach at least 100 km and 7.6 km/s horizontal speed, circularise, then return science data.

name: The far side
subtitle: LUNAR FLYBY
history: In October 1959, Luna 3 returned the first images of the far side of the Moon. A flyby can return valuable science without the fuel needed to enter orbit.
objective: Insert into Earth orbit, execute a lunar transfer, image the Moon, and downlink the observations.

name: A quieter arrival
subtitle: LUNAR LANDING
history: Luna 9 made the first successful soft landing on the Moon in February 1966. Apollo 11 landed the first people there in July 1969. This game uses an uncrewed lander.
objective: Transfer to the Moon, brake into descent, touch down below 5 m/s, and transmit surface science.
